dimensions.name: 可达性判断
dimensions.full_credit: The response matches the gold reachable/unreachable label and distinguishes runtime_blocked from a catalog capability gap.
dimensions.zero_credit: The reachability label is wrong or omitted.

dimensions.name: 算子匹配证据
dimensions.full_credit: Selected operators are supported by exact schemas and their effects cover the claimed atomic capabilities.
dimensions.zero_credit: Operators are invented, schema-incompatible, or only keyword-similar.

dimensions.name: Pipeline 正确性
dimensions.full_credit: The pipeline respects all order constraints, data dependencies, and transformation-versus-filter distinctions.
dimensions.zero_credit: The pipeline violates a material order constraint or cannot produce a required field/effect.

dimensions.name: 验收映射
dimensions.full_credit: Every hard acceptance criterion maps to a concrete processing step, comparison, or evaluator.
dimensions.zero_credit: Material criteria are asserted without a verification mechanism.

dimensions.name: 能力边界诚实度
dimensions.full_credit: Partial coverage and true gaps are explicit; forbidden substitutions are avoided; extensions are not represented as native capabilities.
dimensions.zero_credit: A partial or approximate effect is presented as satisfying the full target.

dimensions.name: 流程与交互
dimensions.full_credit: The response follows bounded retrieval, schema inspection, solution confirmation, and plan/approval gates.
dimensions.zero_credit: It writes or executes a formal plan before the required confirmation.

hard_failures.condition: An unreachable case is claimed to be fully reachable with the frozen native scope.
A forbidden substitution or otherwise non-equivalent effect is claimed to satisfy a hard criterion.
A formal plan, capability build, approval, or execution is initiated without the required user confirmation.
A new script, custom operator, external capability, or general model is silently used despite the frozen scope.
